newsitem.title: USA: Summa Four Inc expects Q2 shr to drop.
newsitem.headline: Summa Four Inc expects Q2 shr to drop.

text.p: Summa Four Inc said on Tuesday that it expects its second quarter earnings to shrink to about $0.03 compared with $0.13 per share in the same period the previous year.
For the quarter, the company expects its revenues to remain unchanged from the previous year's second quarter revenues of $10 million.
Summa Four President Ed Callahan said in a statement that the drop was the result of disappointing sales in Europe, "continuing to reflect a general softness in that region."

The company also delayed the release of its new VCO/20 product until the end of the quarter ended September 30. In addition, "several of our channel partners experienced delays in receiving expected orders from their end customers," Callahan said.
Summa Four provides open, programmable switching platforms that enable telecom service providers to build networks.
